observations.visible_damage: Severe corrosion and rust on the metal housing. Several bent and broken metal fins on the coil. Deposits and residue visible on the surfaces.
observations.explanation: The metal housing shows extensive rust and corrosion. The coil fins are bent and broken, potentially reducing functionality. The extent of internal damage cannot be determined from this image alone.

work_order.title: Inspection and Repair of Corroded Coil and Metal Housing
work_order.description: The metal housing and coil show severe corrosion, rust, and physical damage such as bent and broken fins. Recommend inspection and repair by a qualified technician to assess and address deterioration and ensure system reliability.
